definitions.gloss: city center; downtown area; central district
definitions.explanation: The main commercial and business area of a city or town, where shops, offices, and entertainment are concentrated.

examples.japanese: {中心街|ちゅうしんがい}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: I walked to the city center.
There are many shops in the downtown area.

examples.japanese: {中心街|ちゅうしんがい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{再開発|さいかいはつ}→再開発：17066_saikaihatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んで→進む：01225_susumu⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{建|た}っている→建つ：12544_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: Redevelopment of the city center is underway, and new buildings are going up one after another.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧ (center) + {街|がい} (town, street area). Refers to the main commercial and entertainment hub of a city.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中心街|ちゅうしんがい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{再開発|さいかいはつ}→再開発：17066_saikaihatsu⟧: downtown redevelopment
- {中心街|ちゅうしんがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧: to live downtown
- {中心街|ちゅうしんがい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{活性化|かっせいか}→活性化：07563_kasseika⟧: revitalization of the city center
- {中心街|ちゅうしんがい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{離|はな}れた→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧: away from the center

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{繁華街|はんかがい}→繁華街：09392_hankagai⟧: entertainment district — specifically the bustling, bright area with shops and nightlife
- ⟦{都心|としん}→都心：04072_toshin⟧: city center — specifically the center of a large metropolis like Tokyo
- ⟦{商店街|しょうてんがい}→商店街：09391_shoutengai⟧: shopping street — a specific street or arcade lined with shops
- ⟦{市街地|しがいち}→市街地：17083_shigaichi⟧: urban area — the built-up area of a city in general
- ダウンタウン: downtown — the English loanword, also used in Japanese
